transformations.rationale: The Rust method receiver `self` is represented as the explicit Verus parameter `slice`; the public target remains executable and carries the generated comparator-selection contract.

The source body's `|a: &T, b: &T| compare(a, b) == Less` closure cannot be typechecked by this Verus build because it captures a mutable FnMut comparator. The harness lowers only that adapter to the named source-backed `partition_at_index_by_compare` boundary, borrowing `compare` and preserving the Less predicate.

The recursive private introselect implementation behind `sort::select::partition_at_index` is isolated as a named source-backed helper boundary. The public target function is executable and not `external_body`.
